model: UP Series ultra-low pressure transducer (BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: Greystone UP series ultra-low differential pressure transducers with BACnet MS/TP.
summary: The UP Series is a Greystone ultra-low differential pressure transducer with native BACnet MS/TP. Pressure is one Analog Input; averaging time, alarm limits, alarm delays and backlight mode are Analog Values; Binary Values set alarm enable/test, units and trigger an auto-zero, and three Binary Inputs report the alarms.
notes: Points from the object list on page 1 of the setup guide.
Alarm limit defaults are 75 % and 25 % of the selected range; pressure values follow BV 3 (in. w.c. or Pa).
Auto zero only works in normal mode and within ±7.5 % of full scale; BV 4 returns to 0 after a few seconds.
Access from the object pages: AV and BV Present_Value are read/write.

source.title: UP Series Ultra Low Pressure Transducer - Setup Guide BACnet Communication

integration.summary: Set the MS/TP MAC in the menu, choose units, then read pressure (AI 1) and the alarm BIs. Alarm limits and delays are set once.
setup: Device instance defaults to 381003 (381000 + MAC); it stops following the MAC once written over BACnet.
gotchas: Only auto-zero (BV 4) when the actual pressure is near zero.
